_note: Two kinds of thing. `commission` is the studio's real work and is priced by js/commission.js, because the model is multiplicative and the shared additive priceLine() cannot express it. `edition` pieces are ordinary products priced by shared/core/pricing.js. Everything else in the stack — dates, capacity, cart, checkout — is the same for both.

scale.label: How many it has to feed

options.label: 10 to 15
options.note: One tier, or a single sculptural form

options.label: 25 to 35
options.note: Two tiers, or one large piece

options.label: 60 to 80
options.note: Three tiers, or a table of pieces

options.label: 120 and up
options.note: A centrepiece and a cutting cake behind it

options.label: Clean
options.note: One tier, one finish, nothing stuck on. The shape has to carry it, which is harder than it sounds.

options.label: Composed
options.note: Two or three tiers with things arranged on them — flowers, fruit, piping — in colours we agree before we start.

options.label: Sculptural
options.note: A shape that has to be built rather than stacked: curves, overhangs, things that lean. There is steel inside some of these.

options.label: Editorial
options.note: A one-off for a photograph, a launch or a room. Hand-painted, hand-sculpted, no two the same. We will have opinions.

options.label: One colour
options.note: One colour, every shade of it, nothing else

options.label: Colours that agree
options.note: A narrow range — creams, or greens, or rusts

options.label: Colours that fight
options.note: Two that should not go together, which is the point

options.label: No colour added
options.note: Whatever colour the ingredients already are

_techniques: Add-ons in the catalogue sense, but they are the studio's actual vocabulary. Each carries its own price and its own days, and the ambition level caps how many of them a brief can hold — a Clean brief with six techniques on it is not a clean brief.

addons.label: Hand-piped detail

addons.label: Airbrushed gradient
addons.note: Colour sprayed so it fades across the whole cake

addons.label: Printed edible image
addons.note: Your artwork printed onto edible sheet and laid on

addons.label: Mirror glaze

addons.label: Hand-painted panel

products.name: A commission
products.subtitle: Priced on the page, firm for fourteen days
products.description: Tell us the size, how far you want it taken, and which of our techniques belong on it. The number moves as you go, and it is the number — not a band, not a range, not an email in a week.

products.name: Edition No.1
products.subtitle: Black sesame, brown butter, burnt honey
products.description: The first thing we repeated. Sesame ground on the day, brown butter in the sponge, honey taken further than is comfortable.

products.name: Edition No.2
products.subtitle: Olive oil, dark chocolate, sea salt
products.description: No butter in it at all. The oil keeps the crumb open for days, the chocolate is poured at the last moment, and the salt is there to stop it being a dessert.

products.name: Edition No.3
products.subtitle: Dark cocoa, rye, smoked salt
products.description: Almost black, and barely sweet. Rye in the sponge gives it a sourness that stops the cocoa being a dessert, and the salt lands at the end.

products.name: Edition No.4
products.subtitle: Burnt honey, walnut, sour cream
products.description: Eight thin layers, built the day before so they soften into each other. The honey is taken past golden, which is where most people stop.

products.name: Edition No.5
products.subtitle: Stout, treacle, burnt orange
products.description: Baked in a ring so the middle cooks at the same rate as the edge, which matters when the batter is this dark. The stout does not taste of beer by the time it is out; it tastes of treacle.

products.name: Edition No.6
products.subtitle: Baked cheesecake, juniper
products.description: Baked low and slow until it only just sets, then left overnight. Juniper in the base, which people notice on the second mouthful and not the first.

products.name: Edition No.7
products.subtitle: Lemon, meringue, scorched
products.description: The curd is sharper than most people expect and the meringue is taken to the edge of burnt with a torch. Both of those are deliberate and we will not soften either.

products.name: Edition No.8
products.subtitle: Almond, brown sugar, bay
products.description: The plainest thing we make, and the one we eat. A loaf rather than a tier, cut thick, better on the second day than the first.

products.name: Offcuts
products.subtitle: What came off the commissions this week
products.description: Levelling a tier produces a lot of cake. It is the same cake, in the wrong shape, for a third of the price. We never know what is in the box until Friday.
